sam.cs: Quick update 1: Saffron Diagnostics signed up for Preview cohort. They want a focused 30-day plan emphasizing improved search relevance and predictable cost. Renewal looks tied to early wins.

jordan.se: Awesome. I'm free Thu mornings PST for kickoff. Do they plan to start on Hosted?

sam.cs: Yes Hosted initially, with option to move to Dedicated if latency/carbon cost looks good. Asking for a compact milestone plan.

mira.eng: From infra: reserve a small Dedicated slot for week3 for load testing. Also request 3 anonymized sample payloads to size token budgets.

jordan.se: I'll run the demo. Plan: 20min walkthrough, 20min hands-on with their payloads, 10min Q&A. Will demo fallback routing + rerank.

sam.cs: Checklist to send customer:
```
- accept invite
- provide 3 anonymized payloads
- run health curl
- share service-account email for logs
```

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Saffron Preview Kickoff  Wed 2026-02-11 09:30 PST  https://zoom.us/j/2468101214 :calendar:

mira.eng: Provisioned 2 preview seats and enabled verbose logging. I'll run a smoke test tomorrow and drop results here.

jordan.se: Can we ask them to run this pre-check and paste output if any errors?

sam.cs: Sending this to customer: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://preview.api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq`

mira.eng: Also recommending quantized 13B for initial prototypes to balance cost/latency. I'll attach expected token counts once I see payloads.

sam.cs: Action items: @jordan.se demo, @mira.eng infra checks + token estimates, I'll request payloads + KPIs (precision@5, p95 latency). Will follow up when customer replies. :rocket:
